'''Markand''' was a [[High Admiral]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He received a copy of a message from [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Mirash Peet]] of [[Indupar]] to [[Commodore/Legends|Commodore]] [[Gor Lequar]].
